visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a dark grey textured hoodie, stands in front of a white shelving unit filled with neatly organized cosmetics and skin care products. She is groomed with light makeup and deep red fingernails, speaking directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. (2) The scene cuts to a high-detail close-up of her lips; first, her finger points to natural dry lip lines, then transitions to a glossy, pink, and visibly plumper lip state. (3) She holds up the packaged VT Reedle S Lip Plumper, pointing to its specific label details including the '90% Spicy Level' indicator. The background remains the bright studio setting with cosmetic shelves. (4) She opens the dark tube and applies the clear lip gloss to her lips using the applicator brush. Her facial expression shifts to surprise and discomfort as she fans her mouth with her hands, indicating a strong sensation. (5) The woman poses with her hand under her chin, showing off the final plumped result of her lips against the same backdrop. She continues to talk enthusiastically, ending by covering her mouth in mock shock.
